title: Availability in nines and downtime budgets

kcs.statement: Availability is the fraction of time (or of requests) a system serves successfully: uptime / (uptime + downtime).
99.9% availability allows about 8.77 hours of downtime per year (about 43.8 minutes per month); each extra nine cuts the allowed downtime by 10×.

problem_ideas: Convert 99.95% into minutes of allowed downtime per month
A service was down 4 hours last year: how many nines did it achieve?
How much downtime per week does four nines allow?
A deploy causes a 2-minute outage each release; how many releases per month fit in a 99.99% budget?
